title: A non-testing characterization of bounded and compact composition operators on $\mathcal Q_p$ spaces
summary: In this paper, we give symbol-only, non-testing characterizations of bounded and compact composition operators on $\mathcal Q_p$, $0<p\le 1$, via a novel dyadic trace formulation over Carleson tents for generalized $p$-Nevanlinna counting functions. Our results resolve an open question raised in Xiao's 2001 book, as well as the diagonal case of Zhao's 2009 question, a longstanding problem in the theory of $\mathcal Q_p$ spaces.
